title: Adding a publish channel to release-cli.yml: wire notify jobs and match gating
answers: How to add a new publish job to the CLI release workflow
Why did a failed publish not show up in Slack?
crates.io trusted publishing setup for posthog-cli
body:
In .github/workflows/release-cli.yml, a new publish-* job (publish-npm, publish-homebrew, publish-cargo) must be added to BOTH `notify-released` (needs list plus an `result == 'success' || 'skipped'` clause in `if`) and `notify-publish-failed` (needs list plus a `result == 'failure'` clause), otherwise failures are silent.
- Gating: publish-npm and publish-cargo use `!announcement_is_prerelease || publish_prereleases`; publish-homebrew is stable-only.
- crates.io auth uses Trusted Publishing via rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action (SHA-pinned) with `permissions: id-token: write`; no CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN secret. It requires crates.io config for repo PostHog/posthog and workflow release-cli.yml, otherwise no token is returned and the job fails.
